test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 12 Oct 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A field is in the form of a circle. The cost of fencing around it at Rs.11 per metre is Rs.2,420. What is the area (in m²) of the field? (Take pi = frac{{22}}{7})
solution:
**Given:**

The cost of fencing around it at Rs. 11 per metre = Rs. 2,420

**Formula used:**

Perimeter of the circle = 2πr

Area of the circle = πr²

**Calculation:**

Cost of 1 m fencing = Rs. 11 per metre

Total length of the fencing = (2,420/11)

⇒ 220 m

Now,

Perimeter of the circle = 2πr

⇒ 2 × 22/7 × r = 220

⇒ 44r/7 = 220

⇒ r = (220 × 7)/44

⇒ r = 35 m

Now,

Area of the circle = πr²

⇒ (22/7 × 35 × 35) m²

⇒ (22 × 35 × 5) m²

⇒ 3850 m²

**∴ The area of the field is Rs. 3850 m²**
